throughline.zh: 台灣設備業者公布封測、雷射封裝及材料工程進度，台達電與光寶科揭露電源業務月報，廣達與華碩則公布伺服器系統交付相關營收。
throughline.en: Taiwanese tool makers reported packaging, laser and fab-engineering developments, Delta and Lite-On released power-related sales, and Quanta and ASUS disclosed server-system revenue.

title.zh: 半導體封裝、測試、設備與材料工程
title.en: Semiconductor packaging, testing, tools and materials engineering

summary.zh: 京鼎上週核准泰國廠房資產交易，本週均華、均豪、志聖及東捷公告設備營收。11 月 9 日業成新增雷射封裝試產規劃，漢測公布高功耗晶圓測試熱管理收入，崇越則說明記憶體廠廢水工程按進度認列；各案分別處於投資、試產、出貨或工程認列階段。
summary.en: Foxsemicon's Thai property approval and Taiwanese tool makers' monthly sales were followed on November 9 by GIS-KY's laser packaging ramp plans, Hermes' high-power wafer-test revenue and Topco's memory-fab wastewater engineering recognition. These involve distinct financing, qualification, shipment and project-accounting stages.

title.zh: 工業電源、機櫃供電與電子零組件營收
title.en: Industrial power, rack electricity and electronic components

summary.zh: 高雄公布中鋼 3.575MW 燃料電池規劃，奇鋐公布既有散熱業務營收；11 月 9 日台達電、光寶科及國巨分別揭露電源、備援電池及被動元件相關業務月報。電力裝置規劃與公司合併營收分屬不同計量口徑，產品出貨仍須各別核對。
summary.en: Kaohsiung detailed China Steel's proposed 3.575MW fuel-cell project, while AVC reported thermal-management sales. On November 9 Delta, Lite-On and Yageo released group revenue linked to power, battery backup and passive components; planned generation capacity and consolidated sales are different metrics.

title.zh: 資料中心施工、供水與伺服器系統交付
title.en: Data-center construction, water and server-system deliveries

summary.zh: 馬來西亞 SunCon 新合約與 4 月同址公告關係仍未釐清，印尼巴淡島居民供水問題也缺乏機房取水因果證據。11 月 9 日廣達與華碩公布伺服器相關合併營收，並分別指出 AI 伺服器與遞延交貨影響，但未公布 GPU 機櫃獨立數量。
summary.en: SunCon's Serendah agreement overlaps in location with an April filing, while Batam household outages lack facility-level causal evidence. Quanta and ASUS reported server-related consolidated sales November 9, citing AI-server demand and recognition of deferred deliveries without GPU rack unit disclosures.

title.zh: 記憶體技術傳聞、擴產計畫與成熟製程成本
title.en: Memory technology reports, capex plans and mature-node costs

summary.zh: 台積電對 3D DRAM 報導重申邏輯晶圓代工定位，華邦電說明先前核准的高雄擴建預算。11 月 9 日來頡指出成熟製程晶圓與封測供應緊張，第三季毛利率降至 44%，其 2027 年成本趨勢仍屬公司預測。
summary.en: TSMC reaffirmed its logic-foundry focus in response to unconfirmed 3D DRAM reporting, and Winbond discussed earlier approved Kaohsiung capex. M3 Technology reported a 44% Q3 gross margin on November 9 and forecast tighter mature-node and back-end conditions in 2027.
